items.title: State Street (STT) Stock Looks Fairly Valued While Earnings Still Look Reasonable
items.summary: State Street stock has delivered a very strong 3 year run, yet the current checks suggest it now trades close to what many models would see as its intrinsic value rather than as a clear bargain. With the Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate sitting near the market price and market multiples also looking about right, investors are left weighing recent gains against a more neutral valuation read. items.title: State Street (STT) Launched A $2.5 Billion ETF With Record Opening Assets
items.summary: State Street (NYSE: STT) and UC Investments launched the SPDR UC Investments 90/10 Endowment Strategy Index ETF with a US$2.5b anchor investment from UC. The ETF is described as the largest ever U.S. listed ETF launch by initial capital. The product aims to make an institutional style endowment allocation available through an exchange traded format. items.title: These IBD 50 Stocks Form Sneaky But Bullish Chart Pattern
items.summary: Sometimes, a bullish chart pattern will sneak up on you when you least expect it. A case in point is the ascending base, a pattern currently found in a couple of IBD 50 Growth Stocks To Watch. Because it appears during a stock's advance, the ascending base is difficult to spot.

items.title: Groww AMC completes investment deal with State Street
items.summary: State Street Investment Management will own a 4.85% voting stake in Groww AMC and a 23% economic interest.

items.title: ETF Asset Flow of August: S&P 500 Tops
items.summary: August ETF flows highlighted strong investor demand for S&P 500, Nasdaq-100, short-term Treasury, gold and bitcoin ETFs, while some major funds saw outflows.

items.title: Better International ETF: the iShares IEFA vs. State Street's SPDW
items.summary: SPDW's ultra-low 0.03% expense ratio and 28.7% one-year return challenge IEFA's $196 billion scale and 3.3% yield.

items.title: Pete Dorsey Joins State Street as Wealth CRO
items.summary: The former LPL Financial and Altruist executive will lead revenue strategy for the asset manager's custody and clearing business as it expands into wealth services.

items.title: 1 S&P 500 Stock with Exciting Potential and 2 We Question
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.
